title: Deliver Copper Ore to Druntbourne Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Copper Ore** delivered to **Druntbourne Factory** (industry id 37, near tile 238,166).

A likely supplier is **Druntbourne Copper Ore Mine** (industry id 25, near tile 238,185); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **500 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
